Sam (Support): Hey folks — escalation from a customer (internal ticket #5128). They started getting 400s from /embeddings after upgrading our TS SDK to v2.1. Error is `400 Bad Request: embeddings: dimension mismatch (expected 1536, got 2048)`. Happening only for a subset of requests (batched), intermittent. Sample logs below. Any ideas?

Sam (Support): logs snippet:```json
{"ts": "2026-03-14T16:12:03Z","req_id":"req_9a2b","path":"/v1/embeddings","model":"text-embedding-3-small","batch_size":8,"status":400,"error":"dimension mismatch: expected 1536 got 2048","client":"ts-sdk/v2.1"}```

Sam (Support): Repro steps customer gave: 1) Using TS SDK v2.1 2) model param left default (no explicit model) 3) sending arrays of mixed precomputed vectors + raw texts (they do hybrid: some items are already vectors from prior pipeline) 4) enable batching (batch_size=8) 5) occasional 400s.

Marta (SDK): Thanks, Sam. Quick hypothesis: mismatch between implicit model selection and precomputed vectors. text-embedding-3-small returns 1536-dim vectors; older model in their pipeline produced 2048. If they mix raw inputs (which we embed) and precomputed vectors (which they attach), the server expects all vectors in the same dimension. If the SDK batch contains both, server returns dimension mismatch.

Marta (SDK): Two remediation paths: a) change their pipeline to only send raw inputs and let us compute embeddings consistently, OR b) normalize precomputed vectors to expected dim before sending, OR c) explicitly set `model: "text-embedding-3-small"` (or whichever model matches their precomputed vectors) in the client so server-side validation is consistent. Also we should detect mixed payloads client-side and fail fast with better error explaining mixed vector vs text.

Marta (SDK): Example fixes. Python (explicit model + small-batch):```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_API_KEY'))
resp = c.embeddings.create(model='text-embedding-3-small', input=["one","two"], batch_size=4, timeout=30)
```

Marta (SDK): TypeScript (explicit model + retry/backoff):```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood-ai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
async function embed(items:string[]) {
  return client.embeddings.create({
    model: 'text-embedding-3-small',
    input: items,
    batch_size: 4,
    timeout: 30000, // ms
    retry: { retries: 3, factor: 2 }
  })
}
```

Marta (SDK): Go (example):```go
c := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_API_KEY"))
opts := redwood.EmbeddingsOptions{Model: "text-embedding-3-small", BatchSize: 4, TimeoutMs: 30000}
res, err := c.Embeddings.Create(ctx, items, opts)
```

Jakob (Eng-Runtime): Quick note: we saw a separate issue earlier where mixed payloads + batching triggered a partial-batch path that attempted to short-circuit vector inputs into the embed pipeline, which could produce mismatched dims if metadata labeling was wrong. I pushed a debug flag to staging to capture more details (correlation id included).

Rico (Oncall): Customer also reported occasional 504s and higher latency leading to client retries which might create duplicate batched requests — could explain intermittent nature. Retries without idempotency can make mixed-type batches more likely. We should advise setting idempotency keys or disable automatic retries client-side for embedding calls that mix raw/vector inputs.

Sam (Support): Customer is using our hosted API (not Dedicated). They said billing and auth are fine. They passed an `X-Correlation-Id` in headers (val: acme-5128-req). They can repro reliably by taking 6 raw texts + 2 old vectors in a single batch.

Marta (SDK): Action items for SDK: - Add client-side validation to detect mixed payloads (strings vs numeric arrays) inside a single batch and throw a clear error. - Default to explicit model selection in new quickstarts or warn when mixing vectors. - Increase default timeout for embeddings in TS SDK to 30s and add exponential backoff template.

Jakob (Eng-Runtime): Action items for runtime: - Add stricter server-side error message when mixed-type batch encountered (explain expected dims and which item failed). - Instrumentation: log model resolved per-request, and the dims of any incoming vectors. I've opened ENG-8213 to track.

Rico (Oncall): For the customer: recommended immediate workaround: split batches so precomputed vectors are sent as a separate request from raw texts, OR ensure precomputed vectors are transformed to 1536 dims that match `text-embedding-3-small`. Also ask them to disable aggressive client retries while we iterate.

Sam (Support): Customer confirmed splitting batches stops the 400s. They implemented explicit model param too. I'll keep the thread open until ENG-8213 merges. Thanks. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket update: ENG-8213 created (priority P2) — eng-runtime assigned to Jakob.

Sam (Support): Follow-up — Marta, can you add the mixed-payload validation to the TS SDK patch? If you want I can attach the customer repro (they gave a small dataset) to the ticket.

Marta (SDK): Yep, will add a PR today. Also adding a small docs note about "embedding dimensions and mixing precomputed vectors" to reduce future confusion.

Jakob (Eng-Runtime): Will add a clearer server error and instrument dims in logs. ETA for merge: 2 business days.

Sam (Support): Great — marking resolved on the customer side for now (workaround in place). Will keep ENG-8213 linked to the support ticket and close once runtime fix is live.
